tool: Pika creative apps — Product Ad, Video Studio, Camera Director, Relight Media

criteria.name: Product specificity
criteria.notes: Official Product Ad and Video Studio pages accept product images/references.[1][2][3] Exact identity in the first 10 seconds is untested.

criteria.name: Output quality
criteria.notes: No AIVP-controlled render or artifact-backed benchmark.

criteria.name: Control & consistency
criteria.notes: No three-run consistency evidence; vendor demos are not independent measurements.

criteria.name: Workflow strength
criteria.notes: Brief-to-ad, referenced multi-shot generation, and alternate-angle workflows are documented.[1][3][5] Setup friction is unmeasured.

criteria.name: Speed & reliability
criteria.notes: No measured queue time, render duration, retry rate, or failure rate.

criteria.name: Cost efficiency
criteria.notes: Official plan pricing is public, but new-app credit consumption and cost per accepted output are not.[7]

criteria.name: Commercial rights
criteria.notes: Official pricing states commercial use and watermark-free downloads on every listed plan.[7] Input/media rights remain the user’s responsibility under the terms.[8]

criteria.name: Automation & integration
criteria.notes: A separate Pika API Club and broad model catalog are live.[9] No endpoint for these new apps was verified.

criteria.name: AU creator/SMB fit
criteria.notes: The browser workflow and free plan lower access friction, but Australian login/payment availability was not tested.[7]

criteria.name: Monetization fit
criteria.notes: Pika.art affiliate acceptance and tracking are unverified; Pika.style is a different product.

analysis: The event qualifies for intake because the workflows are current, primary-source-confirmed, and highly relevant to product video. The verified docs-only floor is 30/100, which is Monitor only under the authoritative score bands. Do not recommend or rank before a controlled run.
confidence_notes: C: official documents and vendor posts only; no AIVP-controlled output, timing, cost, or QC artifact.
